question:
Select the word that best completes the given sentence. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

Vismi had an __________________ fantastic time at the Hyderabad Book Fair.
solution:
The correct answer is '**absolutely**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**absolutely**" is used to intensify the adjective "fantastic" and is a correct collocation. (पूरी तरह से)
 
• Collocations are words that naturally go together, such as "absolutely fantastic" in this context.
 
• The other options: "**elegantly**," "**exactly**," and "**warmly**" do not correctly fit with "fantastic".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Vismi had an absolutely__ fantastic time at the Hyderabad Book Fair.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Elegantly (सुरुचिपूर्ण तरीके से)**: means in a refined or tasteful manner, which does not suit this sentence.
 
• **Exactly (ठीक-ठीक)**: means with precision, which does not collocate with "fantastic".
 
• **Warmly (उष्णता से)**: means in a kind or affectionate manner, which is not a fit here.
